rootCampaignIdentityPolicy.definition: Root campaign instance ID (the campaignId minted for a User Campaign, e.g. camp-mshgi2vf-xdn6x) is an INSTANCE/STORAGE-NAMESPACE identifier, not part of the semantic content-identity contract. Stable durable content entity IDs (npc/quest/enemy/location/faction/... ids) ARE part of that contract and must match across import/reconstruction; the root campaignId itself is not required to and, per current architecture, structurally cannot be preserved.
evidence: src/state/userCampaignStore.tsx's createCampaign() unconditionally starts with `const id = uid('camp')` -- there is no parameter, code path, or UI affordance anywhere in this codebase that lets a caller specify or preserve a particular campaignId at creation time. Every campaign, without exception, gets a fresh random id the moment it is created.

src/domain/portability/userCampaignPortability.ts's reconstructUserCampaign(text, newCampaignId) unconditionally overwrites `data.campaignId = newCampaignId` on every import -- the imported campaign's original campaignId (from the exported envelope) is never consulted for the reconstructed instance's identity; the caller (always a fresh 'import as new campaign' UI action) supplies the target id.
Both of the above are structural properties of the write paths themselves, not incidental omissions -- confirmed by reading the actual function bodies, not inferred from behavior.
rootCampaignIdentityPolicy.enforcedBy: scripts/final-cutover/verify-root-campaign-identity-policy.mjs (new this pass, npm run verify:root-campaign-identity-policy) -- static guard asserting both invariants above hold and that this report's case is recorded as 'B'.

impactOnParity: None, per rootCampaignIdentityPolicy Case B above: since root campaignId was never part of the semantic content-identity contract (the architecture cannot preserve it across creation or import even in the success path), the loss of these 2 historical root ids is a real, disclosed historical incident but does NOT constitute a semantic content parity gap. Content parity (stable entity ids, relations, counts) for the 3 present Caldran campaigns is fully verified against canonicalCaldranBaseline above and is unaffected by which root id each campaign happens to carry.
